forecast.generalSituationZh: 受強烈東北季候風及一道雲帶影響，華南地區今明兩日顯著轉涼，未來一兩日廣東沿岸相當清涼，內陸地區早晚寒冷。隨著覆蓋廣東的雲帶在週末轉薄，該區日夜溫差較大，早上仍然相當清涼。預料一股達強風程度的偏東氣流會在下週初影響華南沿岸，該區雲量增多，氣溫稍為回升。而另一股東北季候風會在下週中期影響華南，該區氣溫將再度下降及有幾陣雨。
forecast.generalSituationEn: Under the influence of an intense northeast monsoon and a band of clouds, it will become appreciably cooler over southern China today and tomorrow. The weather will be rather cool over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be cold in the morning and at night over inland areas. With the band of clouds covering Guangdong thinning out during the weekend, the temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over the region. It will still be rather cool in the morning. A strong easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of southern China early next week. It will be cloudier with temperatures rising slightly over the region. Another surge of the northeast monsoon will affect southern China midweek next week. Temperatures will fall again and there will be a few rain patches over the region.

days.weatherZh: 大致多雲，有一兩陣微雨。
days.weatherEn: Mainly cloudy with one or two light rain patches.
days.windZh: 北風4至5級，離岸及高地間中6級。
days.windEn: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.

days.weatherZh: 氣溫進一步下降。多雲，天氣相當清涼，有幾陣雨。

days.windZh: 北至東北風4至5級，離岸及高地間中6級。
days.windEn: North to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.

days.windZh: 東北風4至5級，初時高地間中6級。
days.windEn: Northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 on high ground at first.

days.windEn: East force 5, force 6 offshore and on high ground.

days.windZh: 東風4級，初時5級，離岸及高地間中6級。
days.windEn: East force 4, force 5 at first, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.
